translation: (Three cun above the outer ankle is a point of Foot Taiyang.) Ascending straight it follows the outer border of the thigh, [then] follows behind the flank to the hip. Above, it joins Hand Taiyang and the Yang Wei at Naoshu (SI10) (in the depression on the upper border of the scapula below the large bone behind the shoulder). Ascending along the outer border of the shoulder-blade, it joins Hand Yangming at Jugu (LI16) (ascending at the shoulder tip within the depression in the crevice between the two forked bones), and joins Hand Yangming and Shaoyang at Jianyu (LI15).
